doc.title: Jim Cullum interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007

title: Closing remarks and the long-running San Antonio gig
summary: Thanks, table jokes, and Cullum notes the band is going into its 44th year at the club.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well this has been a fascinating conversation for me.
If I come down there I expect to get a front row little table. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -18-
The tables are twenty inches. They’re round and they’re twenty inches.
Yeah. That’s great. Well you have probably one of the longest running steady gigs of any musician I know.
Yeah. That’s saying something. Well best of continued luck to you and to your staff.
